the recorded RAN5 graph, list all level-2 sections belonging to spec 38.521-2 across its stored release versions. Return sectionId, sectionNumber and sectionTitle as an unordered set; Retain the recorded sectionId rather than collapsing records to sectionNumber."}

output.query:
MATCH (spec:Spec), (section)
WHERE spec.specNumber = '38.521-2'
  AND (section:Section OR section:ConformanceTest)
  AND section.level = 2
  AND (EXISTS { MATCH (spec)-[:HAS_SECTION]->(section) }
       OR EXISTS { MATCH (section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(spec) })
RETURN DISTINCT section.sectionId AS sectionId,
                section.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber,
                section.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle
